label: build S9 1/2
result:
S9 unit 1 is finished: the main Words pages are built on branch `v2/s9` in 9 commits. Nothing is left uncommitted, the branch is free (HEAD detached) and the port 8029 server is stopped. `PYTHONPATH=. python3 server/test_flow.py` prints "all good". I checked every page in headless Chromium at 1280 and 390. None had console errors, none scrolled sideways at 390, and the Today's words panel is on every page except the runner.

On the user's question relayed in the brief ("how much did we lose"): for S9, nothing. No `v2/s9` branch existed when I started (only the server branches `v2/s9s` and `v2/s9-server`), so this unit started clean from master and there was no earlier S9 pages work to lose.

**What I built** (worktree `/Users/workingmyassof/freshbot/satbank/.claude/worktrees/wf_52a6cb52-1a2-9`):
- **`web/assets/words-ui.js`** (shared by all Words pages):
  - the Words tabs, the Today's words panel and the By exam day card;
  - the word sheet, including the covered self-test with Know / Don't know;
  - the Add a word sheet, Bring words (from a text, a word list, a missed question), tap-to-define and speak.
- **`web/words/index.html`**, the Library:
  - title row, Today's words panel, the four-tile strip and By exam day;
  - collection groups, the filter bar with the URL keeping every filter, Meanings, Select;
  - the grid, the transitions logic map, root tiles and the sticky study bar.
- **`web/words/study/index.html`**, study setup: every deck with its count, all card and quiz options, and an At a glance panel with Start. Last choices are remembered.
- **`web/words/run/index.html`**, the runner:
  - flashcards, Learn, Commit first and Fix cards;
  - quiz items with the predict or logic step first where the server sends one;
  - Twin, Another choice also fits, move on by itself, the per-question timer;
  - Order the ladder, Type it, placement and triage, Sprint, the Words check;
  - the summary.
- **`web/words/mine/index.html`**, My words: the 12 filter tiles, the forecast, trap and logic mix-up panels, calibration and recall, Import and Export CSV, the table and word wall, the bulk bar.
- **`web/vocabulary/index.html`** redirects to `/words/`.

**Left for unit 2 (not built):** the placement page `/words/start/` (placement works inside the runner for now), the worksheet print page `/words/print/` (Print is left out of the quiz modes), offline cards (`sw.js`), list Share, renaming and deleting lists, and "Another like this" on the daily items.

**Could not check with this database:** Word/Transition of the day always came back empty, and a Words check is refused ("not enough reviewed items"). Both pages handle these cases, but the answering flows for them are untested.

**Server changes needed** (none made; every one is in a file I don't own):
- `api_words.py`:
  - `GET /api/words` should include the lists saved through `word_lists` and the student's own lists; right now a New list or a saved list never appears.
  - It should also send family names and root meanings, so the Family filter and root tiles don't show raw ids.
  - Card runs ignore `direction: 'commit'`, so "Commit first" in setup does nothing.
  - Type it items need the first letter (for example a `first` field) for the hint button to work; it is disabled until then.
  - Decks for claimed, family and pair aren't supported; the pages send the word list instead.
  - A whole quiz run is refused when one word has no reviewed frame. For the quick Quiz button, the client then retries with the meaning types only.
  - Today's words has no way to switch parts on or off, so the preview only lists them.
  - "Same word, new text" sometimes brings back the same text.
- **F2 `ui.js`:** `UI.start(item)` sends any Up next item without an `href` to `/practice/session/`. A Words item needs to go to `/words/run/?id=`; my own summary handles it.
- **F3 `question.js`:** the clue highlight is `.span-clue`, but W1's check 7 looks for `.clue`.
